passages.text: At a small bakery, a customer finds that her biscuits are broken when she gets home. The owner asks our class for a new design for the box. We look at the old box and notice large empty spaces inside. Anya folds thick paper into small parts to keep each biscuit in its own space. Our group tests the box by carrying it around the playground. The biscuits stay whole, so the owner tries our idea in the shop. She also thanks the buyer for telling her about the problem.

parallelText.en: At a small bakery, a customer finds that her biscuits are broken when she gets home.
parallelText.zh: 一位顾客从小面包店回到家后，发现饼干碎了。

parallelText.en: The owner asks our class for a new design for the box.
parallelText.zh: 店主向我们班征求盒子的新设计。

parallelText.en: We look at the old box and notice large empty spaces inside.
parallelText.zh: 我们看了旧盒子，发现里面有很大的空隙。

parallelText.en: Anya folds thick paper into small parts to keep each biscuit in its own space.
parallelText.zh: 安雅把厚纸折成小隔档，让每块饼干各有位置。

parallelText.en: Our group tests the box by carrying it around the playground.
parallelText.zh: 我们小组提着盒子绕操场走，测试它。

parallelText.en: The biscuits stay whole, so the owner tries our idea in the shop.
parallelText.zh: 饼干保持完整，因此店主在店里试用了我们的想法。

parallelText.en: She also thanks the buyer for telling her about the problem.
parallelText.zh: 她还感谢那位买家告诉她这个问题。

wordHelp.meaning: a shop where bread and similar food are made or sold

passages.text: At the library, people of different ages meet to make a booklet of poems. One senior, Mrs Hua, brings a poem she remembers from childhood. Chen, an adult, volunteers to help arrange the page. Mrs Hua explains why she chose the poem, and Chen writes her words beside it. They check the page together before adding it to the booklet. A child reads their page and asks Mrs Hua about the place in the poem. The little book becomes the beginning of a much longer conversation.

parallelText.en: At the library, people of different ages meet to make a booklet of poems.
parallelText.zh: 在图书馆，不同年龄的人聚在一起制作一本诗歌小册子。

parallelText.en: One senior, Mrs Hua, brings a poem she remembers from childhood.
parallelText.zh: 一位长者华太太带来一首童年记得的诗。

parallelText.en: Chen, an adult, volunteers to help arrange the page.
parallelText.zh: 成年人陈主动提出帮忙排版。

parallelText.en: Mrs Hua explains why she chose the poem, and Chen writes her words beside it.
parallelText.zh: 华太太解释选诗的原因，陈把她的话写在诗旁边。

parallelText.en: They check the page together before adding it to the booklet.
parallelText.zh: 他们共同检查这一页，然后把它加进小册子。

parallelText.en: A child reads their page and asks Mrs Hua about the place in the poem.
parallelText.zh: 一个孩子读了这一页，问华太太诗里那个地方的事。

parallelText.en: The little book becomes the beginning of a much longer conversation.
parallelText.zh: 这本小书成了一段更长交谈的开端。
